new_src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if divider is not None:
        a, b = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
        ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[3 if a[i][j] == ca and b[i][j] == cb else 5
                 for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(a))]
    divider = next((j for j in range(w) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1), None)
    if divider is None:
        raise ValueError("no solid divider")
    a = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    b = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if a[i][j] == ca and b[i][j] == cb else 5
             for j in range(len(a[0]))] for i in range(h)]
'''

new_src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    candidates = []
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            candidates.append((counts[row[0]], "row", i))
    for j in range(w):
        col = [row[j] for row in grid]
        if len(set(col)) == 1:
            candidates.append((counts[col[0]], "col", j))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("no solid divider")
    _, axis, index = min(candidates)
    if axis == "row":
        a, b = grid[:index], grid[index + 1:]
        height, width = len(a), w
    else:
        a = [row[:index] for row in grid]
        b = [row[index + 1:] for row in grid]
        height, width = h, len(a[0])
    ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
    cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
    total_a, total_b = sum(ca.values()), sum(cb.values())
    common = set(ca) & set(cb)
    shared_bg = [c for c in common if ca[c] / total_a > .25 and cb[c] / total_b > .25]
    if shared_bg:
        bg_a = bg_b = max(shared_bg, key=lambda c: ca[c] / total_a + cb[c] / total_b)
    else:
        bg_a, bg_b = ca.most_common(1)[0][0], cb.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if a[i][j] == bg_a and b[i][j] == bg_b else 5
             for j in range(width)] for i in range(height)]
'''

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    candidates = [(counts[row[0]], "row", i) for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    candidates += [(counts[grid[0][j]], "col", j) for j in range(w) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1]
    _, axis, index = min(candidates)
    if axis == "row":
        a, b = grid[:index], grid[index + 1:]
        height, width = len(a), w
    else:
        a, b = [row[:index] for row in grid], [row[index + 1:] for row in grid]
        height, width = h, len(a[0])
    common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    color = next(iter(common))
    if color == 9:
        color = 2
    return [[3 if a[i][j] == color and b[i][j] == color else color
             for j in range(width)] for i in range(height)]
